description: This file contains shell script functions for managing PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) interfaces, including scripts for pre-up, up, ipv6-up, down, ipv6-down events, as well as configuration setup for PPP options and secrets. It appears to be part of network setup or configuration scripts for a router or similar device.

methods.name: prepare_pppd_ip_pre_up_script
methods.description: Generates the script to be run before bringing up the PPP interface, setting system variables and logging events.

methods.name: prepare_pppd_ip_up_script
methods.description: Creates the script executed when the PPP link is established, setting network parameters, DNS, and routing.

methods.name: prepare_pppd_ipv6_up_script
methods.description: Sets up the script for IPv6-specific PPP events, configuring acceptance of router advertisements.

methods.name: prepare_pppd_ip_down_script
methods.description: Prepares the shutdown script for PPP, cleaning up and updating status.

methods.name: prepare_pppd_ipv6_down_script
methods.description: Creates the IPv6 PPP down event script, which currently only sets permissions.

methods.name: prepare_pppd_options
methods.description: Writes the configuration options for pppd based on system configuration settings.

methods.name: prepare_pppd_secrets
methods.description: Creates secrets files for PAP and CHAP authentication based on system configuration.

methods.name: do_stop_wan_monitor
methods.description: Stops the WAN monitor process if running.

methods.name: do_start_wan_monitor
methods.description: Starts the WAN monitor process after stopping any existing instance.
